criteria.silhouette_scale: Texture-only refinement of the existing inspected engine; no geometry changes. Generated four-panel sheet supplies surface treatment, not new geometry.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Surface master reduces to pixel-art panels; nine-slice fitting preserves corner size on named native faces. Small rim/spoke edge accents are authored pixel strips, not additional cubes.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: All existing geometry, pivots, supports and rotation clearances retained. No new mechanical forms implied by this sheet.
criteria.period_materials: Steel corner protectors, recessed cast panels, restrained brass pinstriping and small identification plaques fit maintained Tesla-era machinery. Muted enamel band adds restrained color.
criteria.family_consistency: Referenced current material master and actual model; common iron/steel/brass remain. Body accents are muted, no gold-covered casing or arbitrary gears.
criteria.controls_readability: Existing isolated gauge and physical lever retained. New panel art adds no fake controls or lettering.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Textures and UV layout only. Shared casing, removed black lip, recipes and controls retained.
